jobs.description: SCHOTT is a leading international technology group in the areas of specialty glass and glass-ceramics. With more than 130 years of outstanding development, materials and technology expertise we offer a broad portfolio of high-quality products and intelligent solutions. SCHOTT is an innovative enabler for many industries, including the home appliance, pharmaceutical, electronics, optics, life sciences, automotive and aviation industries. SCHOTT strives to play an important part of everyone's life and is committed to innovation and sustainable success. The parent company, SCHOTT AG, has its headquarters in Mainz (Germany) and is  solely owned by the Carl Zeiss Foundation. As a foundation company, SCHOTT assumes special responsibility for its employees, society and the environment.About usThe M&A team drives SCHOTT's strategic growth and transformation agenda worldwide. Working closely with business units and senior leadership, the team supports acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, and other strategic initiatives that shape the company's future.Your Contribution- Support the execution of domestic and international M&A transactions.- Build financial models and perform company valuations (DCF, trading and transaction multiples).- Analyze markets, business models, and investment opportunities.- Coordinate due diligence processes and cross-functional workstreams.- Support project planning, stakeholder management, and transaction processes.- Prepare decision-making materials for management and steering committees.- Contribute to M&A best practices, tools, templates, and strategic projects.Your Profile- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Business Informatics, or a related field.- Initial professional experience in M&A, Transaction Services, Valuation, or Corporate Finance.- Strong analytical skills and solid understanding of financial concepts.- Experience with financial modeling and company valuation methodologies.- Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; M&A database knowledge is a plus.- Strong organizational, communication, and project management capabilities.- Fluent in German and English.Your BenefitsSCHOTT's openness to promote your further development is just as great as our additional benefits. Ranging from active health management via flexible working hours and hybrid work all the way to corporate pension plans: everything geared to suit your goals and needs. Discover a special corporate culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop their entire potential.At SCHOTT, you can expect a unique corporate culture where we emphasize equity, diversity, and inclusion. We know: motivated and committed employees are the precondition for the success of our company.Talent development; Multiple career opportunities; Trust-based working timePlease feel free to contact usYou can expect interesting tasks and challenging projects, as well as motivated and friendly teams in fields that influence our future. Do you want to be successful with us? Then, please send us your application: SCHOTT AG, Human Resources, Heike Haertling,*At SCHOTT, it's your personality that counts - not your gender, your identity, or origin.Talent developmentTrust-based working timeMultiple career opportunities

(m/w/d)English version below.Ihre Aufgaben- Sie beraten Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen und entwickeln passgenaue Wärmetauscherlösungen- Sie sind verantwortlich für die kommerzielle und Key Accounts in technischen Fragestellungen, bauen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aus und unterstützen bei der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer Servicekonzepte- Sie ermitteln das hinter konkreten Applikationen stehende Kunden-, Markt- und Servicepotenzial- Sie arbeiten eng mit Technology, Konstruktion, Produktion, Auftragsabwicklung und externen Vertriebsorganisationen zusammen, um technisch und wirtschaftlich überzeugende Lösungen sicherzustellen- Sie unterstützen die Weiterentwicklung der Vertriebs- und Serviceprozesse sowie die Standardisierung von Angeboten, Kalkulationen und DokumentationenIhre Qualifikation- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen- Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Investitionsgüter, idealerweise ergänzt um Erfahrung im Design von Wärmetauschern- Systematische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Einsatz- und Reisebereitschaft- Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Angebotserstellung und Vertragsverhandlung sowie Kenntnisse in der Durchführung thermodynamischer Berechnungen- Kundenorientiertes Auftreten, verlässliche Kommunikation intern + extern, Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen in wirtschaftlich attraktive Angebote zu überführen- Sehr gute Englisch und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und sichere Anwenderkenntnisse im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Produkten und CRM-SystemenWas Sie bei uns erwartetBei der Kelvion Machine Cooling Systems GmbH trifft Tradition auf innovative Zukunft. Als Teil eines modernen, weltweit operierenden Konzerns mit mittelständisch aufgebauten Standorten bieten wir Ihnen:- Ein sehr gutes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit einem motivierten Team- Eine Ihrem Erfahrungs- und Ausbildungsstand angemessene Vergütung nach TV M+E inkl. aller tariflichen Zusatzleistungen- Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 38 Std./Woche im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells und 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr- Mobiles Arbeiten auf Basis unserer Konzern-Betriebsvereinbarung- Eine vom Arbeitgeber unterstützte betriebliche Altersvorsorge- Gute persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten- Ein Tätigkeitsumfeld mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien Haben wir Ihr Interesse an einer vielseitigen Tätigkeit bei uns geweckt?Dann freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung!GSE Application Engineer (m/f/d)Welcome to Kelvion. Heat exchange is our business. Worldwide.As a global technology leader, Kelvion has been developing and manufacturing heat exchangers for a wide range of industrial applications since the 1920s. We provide tailored solutions designed to meet even the most challenging operating conditions.To strengthen our Global Solutions & Engineering team in Herne, we are looking for a: GSE Application Engineer (m/f/d)Your Responsibilities- Provide technical advice to customers and develop heat exchanger solutions tailored to their specific requirements- Prepare technical and commercial quotations and provide hands-on support to our sales teams.- Use market intelligence to understand customer needs, identify sales potential and turn these insights into new business opportunities.- Support the development of new business by providing technical expertise, preparing quotations and contributing to the acquisition of new customers and projects.- Review customer specifications and define the required scope of supply, taking serviceability, spare parts availability and customer-specific operating conditions into account.- Perform thermodynamic calculations and process engineering design and select suitable components.- Provide technical support to existing customers and key accounts, build long-term customer relationships and contribute to the development of tailored service solutions.- Assess the customer, market and service potential of specific applications.- Work closely with Technology, Engineering, Production, Order Processing and our sales organizations to develop solutions that are both technically sound and commercially attractive.- Contribute to the continuous improvement of our sales and service processes, including the standardization of quotations, calculations and documentation.Your Qualifications- A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.- Previous experience in the sales of technically complex capital goods, ideally combined with experience in heat exchanger design.- A structured and systematic way of working, a hands-on attitude and a willingness to travel.- Solid experience in preparing quotations and negotiating contracts, as well as knowledge of thermodynamic calculations.- A strong customer focus, confident communication with internal and external stakeholders and strong negotiation skills.- The ability to translate technical requirements into compelling and commercially viable solutions.- Very good written and spoken German and English, as well as confidence in using common Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.What we offerAt Kelvion Machine Cooling Systems GmbH, we combine a long-standing tradition with a forward-looking approach. As part of a modern, globally operating group with the benefits of a medium-sized local organization, we offer:- A friendly and collaborative working environment with a motivated team.- Competitive remuneration in accordance with the German Metal and Electrical Industry Collective Agreement (TV M+E), including additional collectively agreed benefits.- A 38-hour working week, flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave.- Mobile working in accordance with our Group Works Agreement.- An employer-supported company pension scheme.- Opportunities for personal and professional development.- The chance to work with innovative, future-oriented technologies.Ready to take on a varied role and become part of our team? We look forward to receiving your application!

You will work closely with our scientists and engineers, assisting with experiments, sample preparation, equipment operation, and pilot-scale production processes.Key Responsibilities- Support laboratory experiments and sample preparation- Assist with production line operations and process runs- Perform routine equipment maintenance and troubleshooting- Ensure lab and production areas meet safety and quality standards- Document experimental and production data accurately- Follow all laboratory, production, occupational health, and safety procedures, including appropriate use of PPE and safe handling of materials and equipmentRequirements- Completed technical vocational training (Ausbildung) or at least 1 year equivalent hands-on experience in a lab/production environment- Reliable, detail-oriented, safety-conscious- Comfortable working both independently and in a team- Good English and German proficiency required for workplace and safety communicationWhat We Offer- Hands-on role in a growing deep-tech startup- Direct exposure to cutting-edge materials technology- Small, motivated team with flat hierarchies- Competitive salaryHow to ApplyPlease apply online at career.mechsyn.com (https://career.mechsyn.com/?job=7a1e2c10-0002-4c5e-9a00-6d6563687379) : create your application, answer a few short questions, upload your CV and, if you like, add a note or cover letter. jobs.occupation: Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) – JVM (Kotlin, Compose) in MedTech (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Senior Software Developer (m/f/d) – JVM (Kotlin, Compose) in MedTechEmployer: PERCEPTEC GmbH Location: Technologie- und Innovationspark, Moritz-von-Rohr-Str. 1a, 07745 Jena Employment type: Full-time (partially remote work possible)Start: ImmediatelyAbout usPERCEPTEC GmbH is a young, innovation-driven and multi-award-winning company in the heart of Jena's start-up community. We develop new diagnostic methods in optometry and ophthalmology — driven by the disruptive changes happening in eye care. Right now, we are building a virtual eye test. It determines visual impairments of the human eye reliable and quick without an examiner.Our tech stackJVM (Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform, Gradle, JDK 21, SQLDelight with SQLite, Koin).How we workWe make heavy use of agentic AI coding to speed up software development.Your roleYou build the application that opticians, optometrists and ophthalmologists use every day. It is Software in a Medical Device under the EU MDR. That means documentation, traceability and patient safety are part of every feature, not a separate phase.You own client features end to end. You shape the architecture with us. You also connect the app to components built outside it — a measurement device SDK and AI models developed with our external partners.You will be one of two developers in a team of six.Your tasks- Build features in our Kotlin desktop application, from the domain logic to the screen.- Extend our own design system. It is generated from Figma design tokens and built on Compose.- Integrate externally developed components behind clean interfaces. Own what the app does when they fail.- Integrate the AI models our partners develop into the diagnostic workflow. Work together with our partners and bring your own AI knowledge to find a good solution.- Build our release pipeline. We do not have one yet. It needs signed installers for macOS, Windows and Linux, plus in-app updates.- Write tests first at the seams that matter. Keep the chain from requirement to test visible.- Keep the code clean and easy to change. Review your colleagues' code and expect the same back.- Work directly with eye care specialists. Turn clinical needs into software that works in a practice.- Document everything to meet the MDR regulationYour profile- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.- 4+ years of professional software development experience.- Strong JVM development skills — Kotlin or Java. Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose are a big plus. We are happy to bring you up to speed.- Solid working knowledge of Python.- Experience integrating third-party engines, SDKs or AI models into a product. The ability to improve and tune models yourself, not just integrate them, is a huge plus.- Experience of integrating hardware into software is a huge plus.- Good knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling.- Good understanding of integrating hardware into a software product.- Practical experience with test-driven development, Git and modern build tooling.- Knowledge of building CI/CD for desktop software from scratch.- Experience in medtech or healthcare is a plus. So is any exposure to regulated development.- Strong analytical skills. An independent, structured and proactive way of working.- Very good English and good German (B1+).Your benefits with us- Shape the architecture of a product early, while the decisions are still open.- Permanent employment contract.- Flexible working hours. A remote start is possible until you relocate, then work from Jena.- Participation in the company's success through our employee participation program.- Receive tax-free additional benefits- Not familiar with every technology yet? No problem. We support you with a dedicated program for your professional development.ApplicationWe look forward to your application.Send your CV to jobs@perceptec.de (https://mailto:jobs@perceptec.de) , together with a short description of how you use agentic AI to build software. GitHub or personal projects are welcome.Please state your earliest possible start date and your salary range.

Mechanical Field Service Technician (m/f/d)located in KielAt Caterpillar, we’re committed to our customers, who build a better, more sustainable world with our products, services and solutions. We understand and show the value of why they should choose us. We’re exploring new ideas and opportunities – innovating to discover the breakthroughs necessary for tomorrow’s growth. Through it all, we are one team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mYIDne7Q5ek&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=39)  – creating and delivering world-class products, services and solutions superior to the competition. Learn more about the Caterpillar Experience (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvCYWtWARlk&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=25) . Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.As a Mechanical Field Service Technician, you will provide technical support for maintenance, installation, troubleshooting and repair of medium-speed diesel, gas and dual-fuel engines. You will work closely with customers, dealers, shipyards, and internal technical specialists to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation of CM (Caterpillar Motoren) products.Job duties you will do but are not limited to:- Perform maintenance, installation, troubleshooting and repair activities on Caterpillar Motoren engines.- Provide technical support directly to customers and through the Caterpillar dealer network.- Execute inspections, overhauls and major repairs on medium-speed diesel, gas and dual-fuel engines.- Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, electrical and electronic (MACS and aMACS) system faults.- Conduct root cause analyses and support major failure investigations.- Detect, evaluate and document engine and component damage.- Support warranty investigations and implementation of corrective actions.- Prepare detailed technical service reports.- Utilize Caterpillar digital service tools, remote diagnostics and technical information systems.- Carry out NDT (non-destructive testing) activities using approved methods where qualified.- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to dealers and customer personnel when required.- Participate continuously in technical training programs to maintain and expand product knowledge.- Perform workshop activities including overhaul and assembly work when not assigned to field service activities.- Support special service projects assigned by the Team Leader.- undefinedSafety Responsibilities:- Perform all work in compliance with Caterpillar Environmental, Health and Safety requirements.- Follow customer-specific safety regulations and permit-to-work systems.- Actively promote a strong safety culture and immediately report unsafe conditions.- Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are completed where required.What You Have (Key Skills/Experience Required):- Completed vocational training as Industrial Mechanic, Engine Mechanic, Marine Engineer, Mechatronics Technician or comparable technical qualification.- Minimum 2-4 years of service experience on diesel, gas or dual-fuel engines.- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.- Experience in non-destructive testing (MT, PT, UT or equivalent methods) or willing to learn.- Good written and spoken English skills for communication with international customers and dealers.- Strong customer focus and professional communication skills.- High level of self-organization and ability to work independently.- Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 80%, including short-notice assignments and extended customer site visits.- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and digital service reporting tools.- Ability to obtain required travel documentation, visas and medical clearances necessary for international assignments.- Valid offshore medical certificate and/or fitness for international travel assignments is advantageous.What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):- Previous Experience of servicing medium speed engines or products of Caterpillar Motoren.What You Will Get:•    Varied and challenging responsibilities•    Attractive salary in line with the applicable collective agreement (starting from €3,977, depending on your experience)•    Additional payments such as holiday pay, Christmas bonus, etc.•    30 days of annual leave / working time account•    Company pension scheme•    Bike leasing / public transport ticket / wellbeing allowanceAdditional Information:We are back! This role requires being in the office five days a week.Note - Relocation assistance may be provided to candidates who meet the eligibility criteria.A valid work permit or EU-25/EFTA citizenship is required for this position.About CaterpillarCaterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For the past 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.We value authenticity and encourage candidates to submit original, personally crafted responses throughout our hiring process. Use of AI-generated content may disadvantage your application.

jobs.employer_name: Nicole Cabalzar 4Family - Ihre Agentur für Familienpersonal
jobs.description: Ref.Nr: KVZD2High-Profile Nanny - Spanish Speaking - Live-in Düsseldorf / Long-term Position / FulltimeFor an international family based in Düsseldorf, we are seeking an experienced, warm-hearted and highly trustworthy Spanish-speaking Nanny to provide loving and reliable care for their two children, aged 3 and 9. The family would like a nanny in fulltime, who lives with them.The family lives in a large house in Düsseldorf. The children are expected to attend an international school.  We are looking for a dedicated nanny who can provide a loving, structured and stimulating daily environment while supporting and encouraging the children’s personal, social and educational development. This is a very good opportunity for a qualified nanny to establish a long-term relationship with an international family. You will play an important role in the children’s daily lives and become a trusted and valued figure within the family environment. Given the family’s lifestyle, flexibility and a high level of discretion are essential. The father travels for business approximately once a week, and you should therefore be willing to accompany the family on trips when required.Your Responsibilities- Providing attentive and reliable day-to-day care for both children- Organising and managing daily routines, including school and extracurricular activities- Planning age-appropriate activities and supporting the children’s personal development- Working closely with the parents- Accompanying the family on trips when required.Your Profile- Spanish as your native language or full fluency in Spanish- Good English language skills; German is not required. - Several years of experience as a nanny, ideally within an international private household- Driving licence preferred; a family car is available for work-related journeys- Flexibility and willingness to travel regularly- A warm personality, initiative, excellent organisational skills and a strong sense of responsibility- Absolute discretion, loyalty and integrity. Position Details & Benefits- Location: Düsseldorf, Germany- Position: Full-time, live-in, long-term employment- Accommodation: Private bedroom with an individual bathroom in a spacious family home- Transport: Family car provided for journeys with the children- Salary: Attractive remuneration, negotiable depending on qualifications and experience- Working hours: fulltime- Start date: As soon as possible. A Position of Trust & ResponsibilityThis position is suited to an experienced nanny who enjoys becoming an important and trusted figure in a family’s life. A high level of personal integrity, discretion and emotional intelligence is just as important as the ability to integrate into the family environment and build a lasting relationship based on mutual trust. We look forward to welcoming an exceptional candidate who combines professionalism and warmth and approaches this special role with dedication and a strong sense of responsibility.

Die Technische Universität Chemnitz ist eine innovative Wissenschafts- und Bildungseinrichtung, die sich den Herausforderungen im Wettbewerb zwischen den Hochschulen bewusst stellt. Sie bietet Persönlichkeiten mit ausgewiesener fachlicher Kompetenz, die konstruktiv an der innovativen Weiterentwicklung mitwirken möchten, attraktive Arbeitsplätze. Im internationalen Kontext verfolgt die Technische Universität Chemnitz diese Ziele als koordinierende Einrichtung der Europäischen Hochschulallianz “Across”.Across verkörpert die Vision einer grenzüberschreitenden europäischen Universität und vereint neunPartneruniversitäten in vier Grenzregionen Europas. Unsere einzigartige Zusammenarbeit ermöglicht es uns, grenzüberschreitende Herausforderungen anzugehen, die sich aus steigenden Mobilitätsanforderungen sowie den rechtlichen, wirtschaftlichen und kulturellen Unterschieden in Grenzregionen ergeben. Across verfolgt das Ziel, diese Herausforderungen durch eine Vielzahl innovativer Aktivitäten zu bewältigen, die von 16 Task Teams durchgeführt werden, an denen Mitglieder aller Partneruniversitäten beteiligt sind. Zur Unterstützung dieser Aktivitäten stellt das Across Office eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung des Erasmus+ Projekts sowie eine effiziente und effektive Verwaltung der Allianz sicher.Die Technische Universität sucht ab dem nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n vollzeitbeschäftigte/nProjektmanager/in (m/w/d)(100 %, Entgeltgruppe 11 TV-L)befristet bis zum 31.12.2028 (mit der Möglichkeit der befristeten Weiterbeschäftigung abhängig von einer Weiterförderung).Arbeitsaufgaben:- Sie überwachen den operativen Projektbetrieb und stellen gemeinsam mit dem Alliance Coordinator einen reibungslosen Ablauf der Projektaktivitäten sicher.- Sie wirken am operativen Monitoring von Deliverables, Meilensteilen und Projektaktivitäten mit, verfolgen die Fortschritte der Task Teams und stimmen sich mit dem Alliance Coordinator über relevante Entwicklungen ab. In diesem Kontext bereiten Sie regelmäßige Status- und Fortschrittsberichte vor.- Sie steuern die operative Umsetzung der Erhebung von KPIs und erstellen regelmäßige teil-automatisierte Auswertungen.- Sie tragen zur Identifizierung von Verzögerungen und potenzielle Risiken bei.- Sie bereiten operative Entscheidungen vor, dokumentieren diese und begleiten deren Umsetzung.- Sie fördern die Zusammenarbeit und den Informationsfluss zwischen den Task Teams und dem Across Office und beraten die Task Teams zu operativen Fragestellungen.- Sie entwickeln aktiv Projektmanagement-, Reporting- und Steuerungsprozessen weiter.- Sie entwickeln die Strukturierung und Inhalte das projektbezogene Wissensmanagement-Tool weiter.Einstellungsvoraussetzungen:- Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Bachelor oder vergleichbar)- Fähigkeit in multikulturellen und internationalen Umfeldern sowie im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Kulturen in verteilten Teams auf verschiedenen Organisationsebenen zu arbeiten- Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement, vorzugsweise im internationalen akademischen Umfeld und im europäischen Kontext- Ausgeprägtes Zeitmanagement und Kommunikationskompetenz- Blick fürs Detail und sorgfältiges Arbeiten- Kenntnisse der Erasmus+ Richtlinien und -programme sind von Vorteil- Fundiertes Verständnis universitärer Prozesse ist wünschenswert und von Vorteil- Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für den effektiven Einsatz von KI, Erfahrungen für die strukturierte Einbindung von KI in Prozesse ist wünschenswert und von Vorteil- Anwendungsbereite Kenntnisse mit modernen digitalen Werkzeugen, insb. jobs.occupation: Doctoral Student (m/f/d) as a part of the "Weathering Life" research group (Ethnologe/Ethnologin)
jobs.description: The Max Planck Institute for Social Anthropology is one of the leading centres for research in social anthropology. Common to all research projects at the institute is the comparative analysis of social change; it is primarily in this domain that its researchers contribute to anthropological theory, though many programmes also have applied significance and political topicality.The Department ‘Anthropology of Politics and Governance’ is offering a position forDoctoral Student (m/f/d) as a part of the “Weathering Life” research group(starting as early as the 1st of March 2027)BackgroundThe Department ‘Anthropology of Politics and Governance’ is looking for a doctoral student to join the Max Planck Research Group “Weathering Life”. The group hosts research projects that differently investigate how the weather, and extreme weather phenomena in particular, are experienced, narrativized and rendered governable across the earth’s hemispheres. The group posits the notion that a rise in unpredictable weather phenomena across the world are producing novel ways in which people are building, maintaining or even attempting to cease relationships to the weather: what it clubs together as practices of weathering. The overarching questions that animate the research group are: (a) amidst a shift in global climatic conditions, what are our relationship to the weather today and (b) what do we understand the weather to be? Interested applicants are required to propose a research project that aligns with the broader research agenda set by the group, including methodological plans for long-term fieldwork. We are open to projects that identify places in Europe, Africa, North America and South Asia as field sites, and will prioritise projects where the applicant is able to demonstrate their motivation and capacity to carry out fieldwork in those sites. Tasks and ProfileThe primary task of the PhD student will be to develop, write and submit a PhD dissertation on a subject of relevance to this project. This should include a substantial period of ethnographic field research. Additionally, the PhD student will also be an important member who will contribute to the group’s planning, writing and reading agenda. The candidate should meet the following prerequisites:- excellent master’s degree in social anthropology, human geography, science and technology studies (STS), sociology or a closely related discipline (required)- experience with qualitative ethnographic methods (required) - proficiency in written and spoken English (required)- topical expertise in climate change, climate technologies and weather systems (desired)- experience of working in interdisciplinary contexts (desired)Our OfferThe PhD position is awarded for three years, with the possibility of an extension of 12 months (pending a positive evaluation). Employment will be on a full-time, contractual basis, with sufficient additional funding for fieldwork. The workplace is Halle (Saale), a dynamic, historical town in central Germany (Sachsen-Anhalt) that is home to the renowned Martin Luther University and numerous scientific institutions. The MPI offers a job ticket, company health management, and childcare services in cooperation with local day-care centres.The successful candidate will be integrated into the Institute’s International Max Planck Research School “Global Multiplicities” (https://www.imprs-gm.mpg.de (https://www.imprs-gm.mpg.de) ), which offers comprehensive structured doctoral training and scientific exchange with doctoral students from our partner universities (MLU, Leipzig University and FAU).The Max Planck Society is committed to raising the proportion of women in science; we thus explicitly encourage applications from female researchers. Individuals with disabilities will be given priority, assuming equal qualifications.ContactPlease submit your application electronically by 15 December 2026 following the link for vacancies on our homepage (under ‘Career’), or by going directly to the online application form using the link below. - Signed cover letter explaining your interest in, and suitability for, the position- Curriculum vitae including a list of publications- Three-page proposal for a dissertation project, including details about methodology, and a possible timeline - Writing sample (e.g., a publication or chapter from master’s thesis)- Copies of all relevant degree certificates and academic transcripts from both the bachelor’s and master’s levelInformal enquiries concerning the positions may be directed to Rishabh Raghavan  (raghavan@eth.mpg.de).If you have any questions about the application, please contact:Human resources managementNadine Wagenbrett (wagenbrett@eth.mpg.de (https://mailto:wagenbrett@eth.mpg.de) )We look forward to receiving your completed online application under: https://recruitingapp-5034.de.umantis.com/Vacancies/530/FurtherApplication/Apply/2 (https://recruitingapp-5034.de.umantis.com/Vacancies/530/FurtherApplication/Apply/2)Further information on the research agenda of the Max Planck Institute is available on our website: https://www.eth.mpg.de (https://www.eth.mpg.de)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
